ocl.definition: u:User = User.allInstance()->any(o | o.UserID = userid), valTrue:Boolean = true, valFalse:Boolean = false
ocl.postcondition: u.oclIsUndefined() and let newU:User in newU.oclIsNew() and User.allInstance()->includes(newU) and newU.UserID = userid and newU.Name = name and newU.Address = address and result = valTrue or u.oclIsUndefined()=false and result = valFalse
